metric_definition: total MAE=sum of 10 DMA MAEs; total MAPE/RMSE/NSE computed on summed demand, pooled across origins and horizon. MAPE is a fraction.

provenance.scope: All finite pooled training candidates from archived original campaign and focus audits, plus every saved cohort reevaluated with pooled. Does not prove an optimum over untried configurations or unsaved combinations.
provenance.checkpoint_hash_evidence: Uploaded cohort artifact_sha256 and joint completion_manifest selected_models run_files_sha256; compact upload excludes checkpoint bytes, which must be checked on server before deletion.
